## Design

### 2026-10-09 – Entry #1: MP3 Player KiCad Schematics Design

**2h**

Entry #1: MP3 Player KiCad Schematics Design
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2ipKcadybrkS8p49ZYBiN3uqXILyDrnk/00935560811d1178da6b38b62cded2963b3e5295ae11e724c2e75c55cdd9ad10.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2ipKcadybrkS8p49ZYBiN3uqXILyDrnk/e96924d5e3ec3df2aaf31c4253f0e8f5d7a172d38b7bea59d2a1bfeda26d10bd.png)

Today I started to design a custom MP3 player PCB in KiCad from scratch, which was my first time doing anything of the sorts so it took my a while getting a hang of it and figuring it out. Since Kicad didn't have the actual MP3 decoding module I custom made my own 16 pin symbol from scratch in Symbol Editor. Which in my opinion was the hardest, since I didn't have a premade component, meaning I had to make my own. And I didn't know how to set it up properly which made it even harder. After I finalyl figured it out, I ran the electrical rules checker praying that it would pass the check, and.... IT DID!! Next is working on the buttons!
